retained_special_area_rule: Residual or special individual reporting areas, including Other Asia, nes (490), remain eligible; the exclusion is based on overlap with member reporters, not on nonstandard ISO labels.
rationale: European Union and ASEAN are aggregate reporting groups that overlap their member economies. Including them in the same primary global reporter universe double counts economic activity and changes the materiality threshold.
